issues.description: The problem statement and template expect an assembleBookstore() function with no parameters, but the solution defines assembleBookstore(seed: Double) requiring a Double parameter while main() calls assembleBookstore() with no arguments. This parameter mismatch creates a compile-time inconsistency and will confuse students about the correct signature to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the assembleBookstore function signature consistent with the problem statement and template by removing the unused parameter. Change the solution to define private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore { ... } (no seed parameter), or alternatively update main() to pass a Double and update the problem statement and template to require that parameter. The preferred fix is removing the seed parameter so assembleBookstore() matches the specification.
